unreadable: J6 label 'SCL1_GP3': the character after 'SCL' is blurred and could be read as 1 or 4; recorded as SCL1_GP3 (the GP table also prints SCL1).
uncertain: J1, J2, J6 and J5 labels are printed in boxes beside the connectors rather than at each pad; which box belongs to which connector and the pad-by-pad mapping were inferred from proximity and the GPIO_D/ADC/I2C tags.

gp-header: the GP label table below the 16-pad row does not align pad-by-pad; mapping table order left-to-right onto the pads, and treating 'GP' + number as the pin name, is inferred. The row has no visible designator.
J10 (small connector with 4 fine pads) has a box reading 'SCL_GP21' and 'SDA_GP20'; only two labels for four pads, so it was not transcribed.
Labels of the J1/J2/J6/J5/gp-header connectors are tiny in the render; position 1 at the USB-nearest end depends on the USB connector being the bottom-right 'USB' port.
notes: PCB render printed 'CrowPanel Pico Display-4.3 inch SKU:DIS01243P V1.0'. J1/J2/J6/J5 are 4-pad SMD connectors whose labels are printed in a separate box beside each (J1 box left of J1, J2 and J6 boxes right of each, J5 box to the lower right); box text order (left-to-right, or top-to-bottom for J5) is mapped to the pads in the same direction. gp-header: a row of 16 large pads with a table printed below it: 'GP' row 0 1 2 3 6 7 16 17 22 26 27 28 then GND 3V3 GND 3V3, and function row TX0 RX0 SDA1 SCL1 CLK MOSI MISO CS PWM ADC ADC ADC; labels written as GP<n> with the printed number first in functions. Skipped: J15 UART0 (USB-style connector, pins unlabeled), USB, BAT, buzzer B1 (GP21-BUZZER), TF card slot SD2 (GP6-CLK, GP7-MOSI, GP16-MISO, GP17-CS), J3 fine-pitch FPC (unlabeled), buttons, and J10 (see uncertain).
